_comment: Ratio between ARERA's published reference-customer spend with taxes and the same spend computed without taxes from ARERA's files for the same period. Covers excise, regional surcharge and VAT as a single factor. Recheck when taxes change (usually with the budget law): the workflow opens a reminder every January.

gas.withTaxesSource: ARERA, press note of 2/10/2026: 162.02 c€/Smc for the new reference customer (1,100 Smc/year)
gas.withoutTaxesSource: G2026_stv.xlsx, sheet 'set 2026': average of the 6 mainland tariff areas, reference customer 1,100 Smc/year, G6 meter

electricity.withTaxesSource: ARERA via Il Sole 24 Ore Radiocor, 29/9/2026: 43.43 c€/kWh taxes included for the vulnerable reference customer
electricity.withoutTaxesSource: E2026-smt.xlsx, sheet 'ott-dic 2026': resident, single-rate, 2,000 kWh/year, 3 kW
